model.name: Performance Objective / Review
model.purpose: Represent a governed performance case with scoped objectives, evidence, assessment, correction and purpose-limited disclosure.
model.scope_statement: A performance case is an independently identified, purpose-qualified aggregate for one subject and one governing work context. It owns review-specific objective agreements, evidence assessments and attribution claims, reviewer bindings, period assessments, calibration history, contest/correction and disclosure records. Person, organization, employment, membership, assignment, contracts, original evidence artifacts and downstream employment/pay decisions remain external masters. Internal record kinds retain stable IDs and separate lifecycles; grouping them is not identity equivalence. Startup narrative-only and contractor profiles are permitted. Recognition and scales are distinct record kinds with a future separation hold.
in_scope: Case identity, governing work context, purpose and period.
Objectives, evidence quality, attribution and conflicting claims.
Optional contextual scales, human assessment and calibration.
Typed appeals, corrections, retention hooks and one-object projections.
out_of_scope: Person, employment, position, membership or contract master data.
Automatic hiring, promotion, dismissal or payroll execution.
Intrinsic or portable lifelong person scores and single-proxy productivity scoring.
Certified standard/legal compliance or a production HRIS implementation.

boundary_notes.distinction: Person identity is externally mastered; reference minimal authorized identity only.
Organization identity and reviewing authority owner.
Employment applies conditionally to the employee profile; contractors do not create fictitious employments.
Membership, when relevant, keeps its own relationship identity.
Assignments define work binding; this case evaluates scoped work without owning assignments.
Position and capability requirements are referenced, never copied into period scores.
Original evidence artifacts keep their document identity and retention master.
Contractor agreements remain outside case ownership.

sources.title: Employee Performance Management specification overview
sources.relevance: Observed public object-family overview: objective plans/results, appraisal results and raters. No field-level XSD or license conformance claim.

sources.title: The Organization Ontology
sources.relevance: Role, organization, post and membership separation supplies a relationship precedent; employment legal classification remains external.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.relevance: Entity, activity, agent, derivation and attribution precedents; no claim that provenance proves truth or ownership.

sources.title: Competency assessment LEDA
sources.relevance: Observed distinction between capability assessment and period performance appraisal. Definitions are not reproduced as a licensed taxonomy.

sources.title: The SPACE of Developer Productivity
sources.relevance: Published abstract rejects single-metric productivity. It does not supply an employee rating algorithm or appraisal schema.

sources.title: Performance Management Cycle
sources.relevance: Public-sector planning, monitoring, development, rating and recognition precedent. US federal process details are not universal obligations.

sources.title: Whole-object description profile
sources.relevance: Five-facet applicability and delegated neighboring objects; abstract cases have no invented physical properties.

sources.title: Human capital reporting and disclosure
sources.relevance: Organizational human-capital reporting boundary only. Full standard not read; no formula, clause compliance or individual-score mapping claimed.

findings.name: Revision and successor lineage

Corrections link prior assertions without granting indefinite retention of their personal content. Use a policy-authorized minimal redacted assertion when content is erased; unauthorized loss of the predecessor reference is invalid. The retained linkage itself remains subject to policy.

findings.name: Disclosure and employer change
findings.description: Each Projection describes one canonical object. A multi-case packet is a context pack of separately authorized projections. A new employer receives no former review master by default; any limited excerpt needs explicit purpose, recipient, expiry and authority. Pin the source revision. Disclosing an assessment must preserve applicable dispute qualifications and authorized supplementary statements; exception handling is deferred and the reference validator rejects omission of applicable dispute context. Do not give a one-sided impression by selectively removing an active contest.

functions.name: Open a scoped review case
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Owner and namespace declared; profile does not fabricate Employment.
effects: Creates a draft with no mandatory rating or assessment.

functions.name: Agree or revise expectations
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Authorized owner and work scope; change reason for revisions.
effects: Preserves prior expectation and effective change time.

functions.name: Cite and assess evidence
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Access and compatible use established; master content remains external.
effects: Records admitted, contested or excluded state and uncertainty.

functions.name: Prepare an assessment
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: No activity-only scoring or employment action; missing context stays unknown.
effects: Drafts explanation and questions without issuing an outcome.

functions.name: Issue a review outcome
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Accountable human author; admitted non-proxy evidence; valid optional scale; purpose and conflicts explicit.
effects: Issues review-only outcome and supersedes a prior assertion when applicable.

functions.name: Record a calibration act
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Authorized panel with permitted evidence; distinct before and after identifiers.
effects: Adds an auditable adjustment; does not rewrite source assertions.

functions.name: Resolve or qualify a contest
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Fact correction and opinion contest distinguished; no assumed legal deadline.
effects: Preserves supplementary statement, correction lineage and unresolved disagreement.

functions.name: Produce a permitted one-case projection
functions.description: Proposed governed operation; this specification is not a deployed HRIS action executor.
preconditions: Scoped authorization, field minimization, expiry and source owner checked.
effects: Discloses only authorized fields; never transfers mastership or a portable score.

composition.purpose: Person identity is externally mastered; reference minimal authorized identity only.
Organization identity and reviewing authority owner.
Employment applies conditionally to the employee profile; contractors do not create fictitious employments.
Membership, when relevant, keeps its own relationship identity.
Assignments define work binding; this case evaluates scoped work without owning assignments.
Position and capability requirements are referenced, never copied into period scores.
Original evidence artifacts keep their document identity and retention master.
Contractor agreements remain outside case ownership.

owner_package_requirements: Declared Dimension purpose and accountable owner.
Case namespace, master systems and single-writer policy.
Profile-specific access, retention, exception and agent authority policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Scope cases to the reviewing organization and work purpose; never namespace a portable talent score by person.

canonicalization_rules: Keep case, revision, objective, assertion, scale and evidence identities distinct.
External relationships are references, not mandatory package composition.
patch_rules: Use immutable successor revisions with expected current head and recorded authority.
An erasure or restriction request is handled under applicable policy, not by an unconditional retain-forever rule.
compatibility_rules: Semantic changes to identity, scale meaning, profile requirements or disclosure require a versioned migration decision.
Old cases pin their adopted instrument; incompatible scales cannot be silently compared.

identity_priority: Authoritative master-system identifier with issuer and namespace.
Stable registry-qualified local identifier when no upstream master exists.
Immutable revision identity and source digest as integrity evidence, not the sole person identifier.
artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 timestamps with seconds and an explicit UTC offset; distinguish valid time, observed time, recorded time and issuance time.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Use stable object identifiers plus revision identifiers; human filenames and calendar labels are presentation only.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Hash retained artifacts, retain provenance and validate expected heads. A matching hash proves byte identity, not truth or authority.

policies: One case identity, one governing work context and one explicit reviewing authority; related contexts do not merge masters.
Employee cases reference Employment. Contractor and founder profiles do not require Employment or a numeric rating scale.
Drafts may have zero assessments. An issued outcome requires an accountable human author and admissible non-proxy evidence.
Quantified ratings pin one valid scale version and permitted anchor. Narrative-only assessment has no invented scale.
Unknown evidence or attribution is not zero contribution. A contribution fraction requires a declared denominator and method.
Activity and surveillance proxies cannot be the sole or automatic basis of an issued assessment. Never execute an employment decision.
Contested evidence remains visible and any issued outcome citing it is explicitly qualified.
Allow repeated calibration and appeal events. Preserve before/after references, authority, reason and temporal provenance.
Correction changes an assertion or revision, not automatically case identity. Preserve known history subject to lawful retention and erasure policy.
Recognition cannot mutate a review grade or trigger payroll. Skill levels and grades are not period performance scores.
Each Projection describes one canonical case object. Multi-case packets are separately authorized context packs.
Employer change does not transfer the former confidential dossier or create a portable intrinsic person score.
No wildcard disclosure. Purpose, recipient, permitted fields, source owner, expiry and authority are explicit.
Pure schema checks and example fixtures do not prove production IAM, legal compliance, HRIS interoperability or universal completeness.
Independent external review evidence is stored as actual provider memos. Codex owns this structured synthesis; no provider is credited with emitting its JSON.
Subject/context/program/period is a duplicate-detection signal, not a universal unique key: parallel purpose-specific review lanes require an explicit distinction and independent IDs.
No annual cadence, minimum service period, monitoring practice, rating scale or appeal-depth limit is universal; select an explicit justified program profile.

A disclosure pins its source revision and carries applicable dispute qualifications. This reference release rejects omitted applicable dispute context; exceptions require a separately reviewed future profile.
Preserve original language and translation provenance when a narrative is translated; a translation is not a new human judgment.
Absence, opportunity and accommodation effects may contextualize objectives, but sensitive medical content remains in its restricted master.

A superseded assessment may use a policy-authorized redacted form retaining only authorized minimal identity, lineage and temporal metadata. The model does not grant indefinite retention of linkage; complete erasure or unlinking requires a separately reviewed retention profile.
Post-issuance calibration produces an after-assessment that explicitly supersedes the before-assessment; the previous outcome is marked superseded.
Seven external source entries are primary precedents verified to the recorded scope by Codex; the Vercy whole-object profile is an internal normative reference, not independent external evidence.

read: Evaluate purpose, subject, scope, permitted fields and authoritative access policy before each disclosure.
create: Create a minimal profile-qualified case with stable identity and declared master; initial draft need not have objectives or assessments.
update: Require expected revision, authority and a reason; append explicit correction or calibration records.
delete: Retire or restrict by policy; evaluate retention, legal hold and erasure basis. Preserve only authorized minimized audit metadata. Never promise indefinite retention of personal content.

roles.name: Subject
responsibilities: Provide evidence and supplementary statements; read permitted own-case information.

roles.name: Review owner
responsibilities: Declare governing purpose, work scope, master system and applicable instrument.

roles.name: Human reviewer
responsibilities: Assess scoped evidence and remain accountable for issued outcome.

roles.name: Calibrator
responsibilities: Record justified before/after acts with role-limited access.

roles.name: Appeal authority
responsibilities: Distinguish factual, attribution, opinion and process disputes; record independent disposition.

roles.name: Data steward
responsibilities: Maintain provenance, corrections, policy-qualified access and retention.

roles.name: Agent
responsibilities: Draft questions and evidence packets within delegated read/write scope; never execute personnel decisions.

access.default_rule: Deny disclosure unless purpose-qualified owner policy explicitly permits it; employment, team membership or a model installation alone is not an access grant.
exceptions: Disclosure exceptions are not supported by this reference release. A future separately reviewed profile must define their authority, minimization and honest qualification requirements.
audit_requirements: Record actor, purpose, policy version, allowed field set and result; minimize the audit record itself.

read_order: Nearest Dimension owner and authority package.
Pinned model AGENTS.md and spec.yaml, including reviewable-draft holds.
Companion instance schema and reference fixtures before extending or writing cases.

coverage.claim: Codex-authored structured reviewable draft informed by independent Grok Heavy and Claude Opus 5 High browser memos. Neither provider emitted this JSON. The original Claude CLI attempt timed out and remains recorded. Eight primary-source precedents and synthetic reference cases ground the design, without universal enterprise, legal or operational conformance claims.

checklist.notes: Stable case and separate revisions, subjects and assertions.
Draft and issued guards, correction, calibration, appeal and retirement proposed.
Conditional employee/contractor context and referenced masters.
Valid, observation and knowledge time remain distinct.
Source-cited evidence, attributable judgments and correction chains.
One declared case master; external objects retain masters.
Research schema and bounded reference fixtures, with explicit implementation limits.
Purpose/recipient/field/expiry contract; production enforcement remains a hold.
Conceptual source alignment; full field-level HRIS adapters not tested.
All five facets mapped; physical case properties not applicable.
No universal labor-law, retention or AI-regulation conformance claim.
Only explicit loss-aware mappings may compare contextual scales.

known_omissions: Specialist labor/privacy review and jurisdiction-specific retention, appeal and employee-representation profiles remain open.
Full licensed HR Open EPM XSD and ISO 30414 text/field mappings are not verified.
Production IAM, evidence adapters, retention enforcement and native Dimension instance bindings are not implemented by the companion example validator.
Public-service, collective-bargaining, platform-worker and organizational group-assessment profiles require separate research.
Shared rating-scale, calibration-session and recognition models may need promotion to separate canonical packages after cross-contour research.
Leave/accommodation fairness, multilingual profiles and appeal escalation policies are explicitly designed hooks, not fully validated operating profiles.
ESCO alignment was considered but deferred; no pinned ESCO schema or concept set is asserted.
Reference profile disclosure exceptions, full unlinking on erasure and pre-issuance calibration need separate operating profiles.
Claude no-tools audit read a frozen semantic text summary. Full JSON/code and fixture results were validated locally by Codex, not attested by Claude.
regional_assumptions: OPM is a US public-sector precedent, not universal practice.
Legal requirements are jurisdiction- and purpose-specific; unread sources remain unverified.
adversarial_checks: Concurrent employments with isolated governing context and contested shared credit.
Narrative-only contractor and founder draft without fictitious Employment or numeric scale.
Refuse proxy-only scoring, automatic employment decisions, hidden conflicts and grade changes through recognition.
Preserve correction history and refuse unauthorized master transfer or multi-object projection.
